_meta.note: Configuration only -- no code changes needed to add a region. Numbers are shown to the user with 'Call' links (tel:); the app never dials anything itself and never claims to dispatch help. Verify numbers periodically -- they can change (e.g. India's mental-health helpline moved from the 'KIRAN' 1800-599-0019 number to the Tele-MANAS 14416 / 1800-891-4416 line in the years after KIRAN's 2020 launch).
